_comment: Skills that legitimately differ across repo trees. Anything NOT listed here whose body differs across trees fails --rule crosstree. Each entry needs a reason AND evidence, both non-empty, and must list every tree it covers — the rule validates all three, so an entry cannot silently waive more than it claims. Every quoted line below was verified against the file at the time of writing.

ai-analyst/run-analysis.reason: portable-skills/ is a vendored archive, not a loaded harness tree. Commit 8587639 moved it out of the scanned skills/ tree precisely so it stops consuming skill budget, and no manifest references it.
ai-analyst/run-analysis.evidence: Commit 8587639 'fix: move vendored portable-skills out of the scanned skills/ tree'. grep for 'portable-skills' in .claude/settings.json, .codex-plugin/plugin.json and .claude-plugin/plugin.json returns nothing.
ai-analyst/run-analysis.open_question: The archived copy is missing the `python3 run-analysis/scripts/validate_agent_registry.py` preflight gate that skills/ requires before executing the DAG, and points at a different registry path. Harmless while unloaded; it would be a real defect if portable-skills/ were ever put back on a load path.

ikigai.reason: Per-tree structural convention, not staleness. The .agents copy carries `### Category`, a `Relationships` table, and a Constraints block that the skills/ copy has never had; the skills/ copy carries a Narrative Frame section the .agents copy has never had. The divergence is bidirectional, so neither is a superset and neither can be synced over the other without destroying content.
ikigai.evidence: The Category/Relationships structure is a .agents tree convention shared by exactly the four skills .claude/settings.json loads from that tree: gcc-roadmap, ikigai-gamma-slidedeck, ikigai, openhands-niche-agency. .agents/skills/ikigai/SKILL.md carries a relationship row for `openhands-niche-agency` that exists in no other copy.
ikigai.open_question: A genuine merge (Narrative Frame into .agents, Relationships into skills/) is possible but is a content decision for the owner, not a mechanical sync.

impeccable.reason: One copy per detected harness, installed by `npx impeccable skills install`. The bodies differ only in each harness's own script path and sigil. Codex repo discovery uses a thin adapter that loads the canonical bundle; it does not replace that workflow.
impeccable.evidence: CLAUDE.md: 'one copy per detected harness, installed via npx impeccable skills install'. Re-verified 2026-09-27 at skill 4.3.1 (signed upstream bundle skill-v4.3.1, ed25519 key release-2026-09): .claude vs .agents differs on 8 body lines, every difference the harness path ('.claude' vs '.agents') or the command sigil ('/' vs '$'); .claude vs .github on 4, sigil only; skills/ body is byte-identical to .claude. scripts/codex-priority-skills.json; scripts/codex_skill_setup.py; docs/codex-wsl-skill-compatibility.md.

investor-competitive-dossier.reason: The .claude and .agents copies are deliberate routers, not stale forks. They carry no workflow logic and point at skills/ as the implementation.
investor-competitive-dossier.evidence: .claude/skills/investor-competitive-dossier/SKILL.md: 'Treat `skills/investor-competitive-dossier/` as the source of truth; do not add workflow logic to this wrapper.' Both wrapper copies are ~542 bytes against 9065 bytes canonical.

openhands-niche-agency.reason: Same .agents structural convention as ikigai, plus divergent prose. The only substantive claim difference verified is that the '14k+ MCP servers' figure appears in skills/ and not in .agents. The .agents copy is the one .claude/settings.json loads.
openhands-niche-agency.evidence: .claude/settings.json loads .agents/skills/openhands-niche-agency/SKILL.md. Verified by grep: '14k+ MCP' appears at skills/openhands-niche-agency/SKILL.md:22 and nowhere in the .agents copy.
openhands-niche-agency.correction: An earlier version of this entry claimed the .agents copy also removed '$2k-$5k/month' and '$50k/mo' and replaced them with 'verified MCP integrations'. That was wrong on all three counts: $2k-$5k/mo survives at .agents/skills/openhands-niche-agency/SKILL.md:9, $50k/mo at :438, and the phrase 'verified MCP integrations' exists in neither file. Corrected after audit.
